metadata.description: Content-production skills that moved out of the LitFamily products, one plugin per family.

plugins.name: decks
plugins.description: lit-pptx: finished PowerPoint decks from a request, notes or source files, with its own office runtime.

plugins.name: documents
plugins.description: lit-docx: finished Word documents (.docx) from a request, notes or source files, plus DOCX/PDF to Markdown and in-place edits, with its own office runtime.

plugins.name: figures
plugins.description: lit-diagram-drawer, lit-schematic and lit-scientific-visualization: conceptual diagrams, physical schematics and publication plots of measured data, with the scientific-visualization source the plot skill adapts.

plugins.name: design
plugins.description: frontend-ui-ux and visual-qa: interfaces built from a locked house style and design kit with a responsive interface probe, and verification of a built interface with captured screenshots and evidence.
